# Producer A bounded runtime slice

Source provenance: `HeisLuka/yab@2416bf1af401caa997e588b41285816422a7d59b`.

This directory carries only the runtime crates needed by the current
`open_mature_0x2c_geometry` dependency cut. It excludes `pub-cli`, exporters,
writers, applications, test corpora, and historical execution machinery.

Rar owns the public contract: output is accepted only after the existing strict
Viewer receipt schema, source identity binding, Scene V1 adapter, and Web
acceptance preflight pass.

This is a transitional dependency slice, not a second canonical repository.
